create_model_vilt_for_masked_lm: create a ViLT model with a masked language modeling head for image-text pretraining
build_model_vilt_for_question_answering: build a ViLT model with a classifier head for visual question answering tasks like VQAv2
run_model_vilt_for_image_and_text_retrie: run a ViLT model for image-to-text or text-to-image retrieval on datasets like MSCOCO and F30K
test_model_vilt_for_images_and_text_clas: test a ViLT model with a classifier head for natural language visual reasoning on NLVR2
review_model_vilt_for_token_classificati: review a ViLT model for token classification that outputs per-token logits for text sequences
